interval_method.name: paired percentile bootstrap within each fixed case
interval_method.aggregation: Equal-case mean of within-case mean log paired ratios, exponentiated
interval_method.limitation: 95% fixed-corpus timing uncertainty only. Cases/models are not resampled; no claim about workload generalization. Assumes repeated timing pairs exchangeable; drift/serial dependence may make intervals optimistic. Small repeats limit tail resolution.

aa.memory_scope: RSS snapshots are after each response; VmHWM is process-lifetime peak including replay, model loading, warmups and preceding searches. This is not isolated per-search allocation.

ab.memory_scope: RSS snapshots are after each response; VmHWM is process-lifetime peak including replay, model loading, warmups and preceding searches. This is not isolated per-search allocation.

aa_control: Two baseline-binary processes; reported independently without subtracting its measured effect from A/B.
